$comment: Machine-usable per-product ADF availability dataset for adfast. Source of truth for building jira/confluence 'supported kinds' profiles. Kind names are ADF `type` strings. See docs/adf-coverage.md for the human-readable cited matrix and evidence discussion.

schemaMirror.note: Public daily mirror of Atlassian's atlassian-frontend (upstream @atlaskit/adf-schema).

evidenceModel.jira: Primary: Atlassian's Jira Cloud ADF reference (developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/apis/document/). A dedicated node/mark page (HTTP 200) is positive 'documented available' evidence; a 404 is evidence-by-omission. The reference itself states it is non-exhaustive ('Marks and nodes included in the JSON schema may not be valid in this implementation'). Secondary corroboration: jira-schema.ts (deprecated ED-15676; a minimal, config-gated editor schema, not used to downgrade markers).
evidenceModel.confluence: Primary machine-readable per-product source: confluence-schema.ts allowlist in the mirror (SHA-pinned). It is marked @deprecated [ED-15676] 'We have stopped supporting product specific schemas' and is a stale, non-exhaustive snapshot. Presence in its nodes/marks arrays is positive evidence; absence is evidence-by-omission only (NOT proof of non-support). No current per-node Confluence ADF reference page exists (developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/apis/document/* returns 404).
evidenceModel.shared: Existence of the kind in the shared default schema is evidenced by its definition file under editor/adf-schema/src/schema/{nodes,marks}/.

values.yes: Documented/allowlisted as available for this product by the cited evidence.
values.no: adfast marks the product column '—' (not available) AND the kind has no page in that product's evidence; corroborated by omission. Not a positive upstream exclusion statement.
values.unknown: In the shared schema but this product's evidence neither confirms nor denies availability (evidence-by-omission from a non-exhaustive/deprecated source).

readmeMarkerLegend.ring: adfast README '∘' — present in the shared schema, no documented product availability.
readmeMarkerLegend.dash: adfast README '—' — documented/known not-available in that product.

meta.support: adfast's own handling of the kind, independent of product availability. Most tabled kinds are 'converted' (round-trip through a markdown mapping). 'dropped' means adfast retires the kind: it never produces it, and any legacy instance decodes to plain text (with a fontsize-dropped diagnostic) — text preserved, styling lost. fontSize is the only 'dropped' kind (no Atlassian product supports the mark).

empiricalValidation.coverage: Full: all 45 nodes + 17 marks probed against BOTH live products on ixolit.atlassian.net.
empiricalValidation.method: Built ADF documents containing every node/mark kind (each preceded by an L-<kind> label paragraph) in valid host contexts. Wrote them to a live Jira issue description (ARCH-506) and a live Confluence page (1729232906) via the Atlassian MCP (contentFormat=adf), then (1) inspected the product-rendered DOM in a logged-in browser (chrome-devtools) and (2) for Confluence read the stored ADF back to see which kinds survived save.
empiricalValidation.jira: RENDER is the product-support oracle. The Jira issue view renders description ADF with the shared @atlaskit/renderer. Classification: first-class widget or degraded-but-present = available (yes); dropped (no DOM) or an unsupported-content block = not available (no); a REST INVALID_INPUT rejection = not in Jira's ADF schema = not available (no). File-media (mediaGroup, mediaInline) is attachment-gated and not injection-testable (synthetic ids raise ATTACHMENT_VALIDATION_ERROR, not a schema error).
empiricalValidation.jiraResults: Rendered (available): every node/mark EXCEPT — placeholder (DROPPED, empty span), fontSize (REST INVALID_INPUT), multiBodiedExtension + extensionFrame (REST INVALID_INPUT). Newly render-confirmed available despite documentation-by-omission: taskList/taskItem/blockTaskItem, decisionList/decisionItem, blockCard/embedCard, caption, layoutSection/layoutColumn, extension/bodiedExtension/inlineExtension, syncBlock/bodiedSyncBlock, and the marks border/alignment/indentation/breakout/annotation/fragment/dataConsumer. mediaInline left inconclusive (attachment-gated).
empiricalValidation.confluence: RELIABLE oracle: Confluence silently strips/downgrades unsupported kinds on save; round-trip survival (readback via contentFormat=adf) confirms support, and the browser render confirmed no unsupported-content blocks. File-media is attachment-gated (not injection-testable).
empiricalValidation.confluenceResults: Survived (available): every node/mark EXCEPT — fontSize (mark STRIPPED on save) and blockTaskItem (downgraded to taskItem; kind not preserved). Previously-inconclusive dataConsumer and fragment marks both SURVIVED (available). multiBodiedExtension/extensionFrame/syncBlock/bodiedSyncBlock all survived.
empiricalValidation.artifacts: Jira issue ARCH-506 and Confluence page 1729232906 (ENGINEERING space) — scratch targets, safe to delete.
